ui_bugs.issue: The Pressable for 'Modele' tile references 6 style keys (modelsTile, modelsHead, modelsIcon, modelsTitle, modelsMeta, modelsPct) that are NOT defined in the StyleSheet.create() block at the bottom of the file. Visually the tile renders unstyled: title/meta/percent stack vertically without layout, ProgressBar sits below unstyled text. Function works (tap navigates to /models/{id}) but the design is broken. Reference: /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx lines 105-117 vs styles block lines 193-209.

issues: Modele tile is not styled (missing StyleSheet entries — see ui_bugs). No visible card background, no horizontal row layout, no left-icon container, no big percent. Screenshot captured in run.

critical_code_review_comments: strip_project_financials is called on both list_projects and get_project. PUT /projects/{id} however returns the raw project without stripping — safe today because endpoint is admin-only, but if role scope ever widens this becomes a leak. Consider always applying strip_project_financials on any project payload to be defensive.
server.py at 1773 lines — again flagged as candidate for splitting into per-resource routers (element_types/folders/views/elements/receipts could be their own module).

Missing StyleSheet keys in /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx: modelsTile/modelsHead/modelsIcon/modelsTitle/modelsMeta/modelsPct — this file lints clean (no undefined variables) because StyleSheet lookups are runtime `undefined` (RN silently ignores). Consider a Style-typed helper or TS strict mode to catch these.
Report/element flow correctly skips already-received elements when a new report is created; element_history tracks report_id, so audit trail is preserved.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the Modele-tile visual regression: when main agent added the tile in /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx (lines 105-117) referencing styles.modelsTile/modelsHead/modelsIcon/modelsTitle/modelsMeta/modelsPct, the corresponding entries were not added to the StyleSheet.create() call at the bottom of the file (lines 193-209 only contain: screen, tabs, tab, tabActive, tabText, infoRow, infoLabel, infoValue, schedule, scheduleText, memberRow, memberName, memberRole, reportRow, footer). React Native's StyleSheet resolves missing keys as `undefined` at runtime without erroring, so the Pressable + inner Views render without any layout/decoration. Reproduce: login as admin → tap the only project card → Overview tab → observe stacked text under grid icon. Fix: add the 6 style entries as described in action_items[0].
